### [`ai_update`](../../../../src/ai/ai_opponent.asm#L6) `$1D48`

*routine*

AI of a CPU fighter: sets fighter_input,x and ai_command,x for this frame. X = fighter, opponent_index = the other fighter. Called by a JMP from fighter_get_input ($226d).
